steps.subject: Your Franklin Navigator profile
steps.body:
Hi {{Outreach_Greeting}},

I’m Roger Gillman with Franklin Navigator. We have a Franklin Navigator profile for your business so local residents can find and learn more about you.

You can take a look here:
{{Profile_URL}}

Claiming and managing your basic profile is free. No purchase is required.

If anything needs correcting, or you’d prefer the profile removed, just reply and I’ll help.

We also offer an optional paid Community Membership designed to help businesses get more visibility in the Franklin community, but there’s no obligation.

Thanks,
Roger

notes: The sequence is initial + two normal follow-ups + one single re-engagement 90 calendar days after followup_2, then automatic outreach stops.
Follow-ups and re-engagement never send after a reply, unsubscribe, bounce, complaint, correction/removal request, organization/domain suppression, or other stop signal.
The active sending path remains Zoho direct SMTP/IMAP. Legacy provider runtimes remain disabled.
Every authorized production message BCCs reachrgnow@gmail.com through owner_bcc.
Every message retains a visible isolated unsubscribe link plus RFC 8058 one-click headers, and open/click tracking remains off.

The outreach sequence intentionally stays short and human. It describes Community Membership only as optional paid membership designed to help increase local visibility; detailed paid-feature selling belongs on the verified product pages rather than in the cold-email sequence.
No message guarantees traffic, ranking, leads, customers, sales, revenue, attendance, or any other business outcome.
This copy update does not by itself authorize prospect sending or a volume increase.
